usedFor: TinyURL holds the short links, and Moco receives a task through “Create Task” after “New Tiny URL”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Tiny URL” in TinyURL, then “Create Task” in Moco
bestTemplate.why: A new short link is work that others will see, so a task in a Moco project tracks it.

watchOut: “New Tiny URL” is polling, so a task shows up in Moco only after the next scheduled check.
